executive_summary: Overall revenue was EUR 777076.79 across 16550 units and 10000 transactions. Weekly performance improved, with revenue rising 13.16% by EUR 2044.9 to EUR 17586.22. However, monthly revenue declined 4.22% by EUR 3121.2 to EUR 70768.89, indicating that the weekly recovery has not yet offset broader monthly weakness. Fashion, the United Kingdom, and Canvas Sneakers were the leading performers.
key_insights: Fashion remained the strongest category, generating monthly revenue of EUR 21966.06 and increasing 3.45% by EUR 732.83.
The United Kingdom was the best country, with monthly revenue of EUR 20296.07 and growth of 9.82% by EUR 1815.4. Spain delivered the strongest country growth at 24.65%, increasing by EUR 2296.67.
Toys & Games was the main category drag, declining 19.79% by EUR 3508.55 to EUR 14219.8. Consumer Tech also declined 3.29% by EUR 568.12.
The largest country declines were in the Netherlands, down 34.61% by EUR 3560.41, and Belgium, down 36.21% by EUR 2557.66. Italy also fell 14.64% by EUR 1769.49.

Product growth was led by Canvas Sneakers, up 62.92% by EUR 2157.29, and Action Camera, up 84.35% by EUR 1611.37. These large percentage gains should be interpreted alongside their previous revenues of EUR 3428.61 and EUR 1910.23 respectively, which were relatively small bases.
The largest product declines were Bluetooth Speaker, down 35.39% by EUR 2452.98, Building Blocks Set, down 39.2% by EUR 2349.75, and Board Game, down 16.63% by EUR 1009.7.

Weekly units increased from 355 to 397 and transactions increased from 219 to 244, alongside the EUR 2044.9 revenue increase. Fashion led weekly category revenue at EUR 6303.31, while the United Kingdom led weekly country revenue at EUR 5073.42.
risks: Monthly revenue is contracting despite the positive weekly trend, creating a risk that the latest improvement may be temporary.
Toys & Games represents the largest category-level revenue decline, while several related products—especially Building Blocks Set, Board Game, and Puzzle 1000 Pieces—also declined materially.
Revenue weakness is concentrated in the Netherlands, Belgium, and Italy, increasing exposure to country-specific demand, pricing, distribution, or availability issues.
The strong percentage growth of Action Camera and Canvas Sneakers is partly influenced by low previous-period revenue, so the percentage gains may not be sustainable at the same rate.
The decline in Bluetooth Speaker revenue is substantial and may indicate product-level demand, stock, pricing, or competitive pressure that requires investigation.
recommendations: Prioritise a recovery plan for Toys & Games, focusing on Building Blocks Set, Board Game, and Puzzle 1000 Pieces through inventory, pricing, promotion, and product-availability reviews.
Investigate country-specific causes of the Netherlands, Belgium, and Italy declines before increasing marketing investment in those markets.
Protect and expand momentum in Fashion and Canvas Sneakers, while monitoring whether Action Camera and Canvas Sneakers can sustain growth beyond their smaller previous-period bases.
Review Bluetooth Speaker performance urgently, including stock availability, pricing, promotion effectiveness, and competitive positioning.
Use the positive weekly movement in units and transactions as a basis for targeted campaigns, while monitoring whether this improvement continues into the next monthly period.
